Values retired from an earlier URPS contract (never present as current)

Source: R/urps_count.R
urps_retired_values.Rd

A flat integer vector of counts that were canonical under a prior contract and must not be presented as current. Use it as a guard in downstream code and manuscripts (e.g. fail a build if a figure caption contains one of these as "the 2023 count").

Usage

urps_retired_values()

Value

An integer vector of retired national/CONUS 2023 active counts (e.g. v2.1.0's 1332 / 1329), or integer(0) if the artifact records none.

See also

urps_lineage(), urps_provenance()

Other URPS workforce: compare_urps_artifacts(), urps_count(), urps_counts(), urps_counts_long(), urps_entrants(), urps_entry_counts(), urps_lineage(), urps_provenance(), urps_require_retirement_ascertained(), urps_retirement_status(), use_urps_artifact(), validate_urps_artifact(), validate_urps_ssot()

Examples

urps_retired_values()
#> [1] 1332 1329
# a consumer-side guard:
stopifnot(!urps_count(2023, "board_certified_active", "national", TRUE) %in%
  urps_retired_values())
